messages.subject: Choropleth in Shiny/Leaflet
parts:
Since there has been some confusion in the past about how to use the Leaflet binding's addPolygon function to create choropleth visualizations, here is an example I wrote yesterday:

https://jcheng.shinyapps.io/choropleth/

This example uses polygon data from the maps package. (Note that when calling maps::map it's important to use plot=FALSE, fill=TRUE or else the polygons will look pretty bad.)

Ideally there would be a nice interface over this (like the good work Ramnath has been doing with rMaps::ichoropleth) but I currently lack the time and expertise to do so. Hopefully someday soon though.

-joe
